lines.en: label rindorm25:
I knock on the door, wondering what sort of wholesome activities Rin is up to tonight.
lines.zh: 我敲了敲门，好奇 Rin 今晚又在搞什么健康向上的活动。

lines.en: : Sensei, is that you? Listen, don’t come in. I’m harvesting the organs from a body I found in an alleyway a few weeks ago.
lines.zh: : Sensei，是你吗？听着，别进来。我正在从几周前在小巷里捡到的一具尸体上摘取器官。

lines.en: : That’s not wholesome at all. And there is no way those organs are still usable.
lines.zh: : 那可一点都不健康向上。而且那些器官绝对不可能还能用了。

lines.en: : Who said anything about using them? I'm just doing this for fun.
lines.zh: : 谁说我要拿来用了？我只是图个乐子。

lines.en: : I'm sure you are, Rin. Can I come in now?
lines.zh: : 我信你才怪，Rin。现在能进来了吗？

lines.en: : Sure! As long as you don’t mind the scent of blood and decomposition and stuff!
lines.zh: : 当然！只要你不介意血腥味和腐烂味什么的！

lines.en: : Not everybody's built for that sorta thing, you know?
lines.zh: : 要知道，可不是每个人都受得了那种东西的。

lines.en: : Nope. But I am going to open the door now.
lines.zh: : 受不了。不过我现在要开门了。

lines.en: : Sound good! See you in three seconds!
lines.zh: : 听起来不错！三秒后见！

lines.en: scene black
scene sockredux1
: Heya! I was just kidding. There’s no body in here.
lines.zh: : 嘿呀！我开玩笑的。这里没有什么尸体。

lines.en: : Well...technically, there are two bodies in here. But they’re both living and their organs aren’t really ripe for harvesting yet.
lines.zh: : 嗯……严格来说，这里有两具身体。不过两具都还活着，而且它们的器官还没熟到可以摘。

lines.en: : Can we stop talking about organs now?
lines.zh: : 我们现在能别聊器官了吗？

lines.en: : Sorry. Just got done watching some zombie movie with a friend from another class and I'm having a hard time getting out of gore mode.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。刚跟别班的一个朋友看完一部僵尸片，我一时还没从血腥模式里出来。

lines.en: : Anyway, what do {i}you{/i} want to talk about? I feel like it's been a hot minute since we've had a good talk.
lines.zh: : 话说回来，{i}你{/i}想聊什么？感觉我们好久没好好聊过了。

lines.en: : You wanna go somewhere? Or just hang around and chat or something?
lines.zh: : 你想出去走走？还是就在这儿待着聊点什么？

lines.en: : Why would I have come all the way over here just to ask you to go somewhere else?
lines.zh: : 我大老远跑过来，就为了叫你去别的地方？

lines.en: scene sockredux2
: Probs cause you haven't unlocked my number yet and you do weird stuff all the time. For all I know, you could be here to try and sneak into my sock drawer or something.
lines.zh: : 大概是因为你还没解锁我的电话号码，而且你老是干些怪事。说不定你这次来，就是为了偷偷翻我的袜子抽屉什么的。

lines.en: : What would I do with your socks?
lines.zh: : 我要你的袜子干什么？

lines.en: scene sockredux3
: I don’t know, man. Maybe you’ve got a...sock fetish? I’m not gonna pry into your personal details.
lines.zh: : 我哪知道啊，老兄。也许你有……恋袜癖？我可不想深挖你的个人隐私。

lines.en: : They’re in my top drawer. Take however many you need. I need to buy new ones anyway and this might finally be the push I've been looking for.
lines.zh: : 在最上面那层抽屉里。你要多少拿多少。反正我也该买新的了，说不定这正好给了我一直在等的动力。

lines.en: : Thanks, I’ll just-
lines.zh: : 谢了，我就——

lines.en: : Wait, why did I feel compelled to actually look just now?
lines.zh: : 等等，我刚才为什么真的有种想去看一眼的冲动？

lines.en: scene sockredux1
: Maybe you do have a creepy, perverted side after all?
lines.zh: : 也许你终究还是有 creepy、变态的一面？

lines.en: While that is obviously true, I don’t think I'm ready to stoop to the level of raiding sock drawers yet.
lines.zh: 虽然那显然是真的，但我觉得自己还没堕落到要去翻袜子抽屉的程度。

lines.en: : Let's remove socks from our list of potential conversation topics as well. I don't have any use for your...footwear.
lines.zh: : 那我们把袜子也从可聊话题清单里删掉吧。我用不上你的……足部用品。

lines.en: : I didn’t think you did. I was kinda just messing around, but now I'm not so sure.
lines.zh: : 我本来也没觉得你用得上。我刚才就是随口胡扯，不过现在我可不确定了。

lines.en: scene black
Rin hops onto her bed and pats the space beside her, gesturing me to come sit next to her despite her newfound skepticism of whether or not I am here for her socks.
lines.zh: Rin 跳到床上，拍了拍旁边的位置，示意我过去坐在她身边——尽管她刚刚开始怀疑我是不是冲着她的袜子来的。

lines.en: I'm not.
lines.zh: 我不是。

lines.en: I do sit beside her, though.
lines.zh: 不过我确实在她身边坐下了。

lines.en: scene rindormbed1
: So! Whatcha wanna talk about?
lines.zh: : 那么！你想聊什么？

lines.en: : I’ll just wait for you to come up with something since I am very much not the talkative one here.
lines.zh: : 我就等你先想出一个话题吧，因为在这儿我绝对算不上话多那个。

lines.en: : Gotcha. Then, do you want to hear about the latest development in my hopeless pursuit of a girl who probably doesn’t even like girls?
lines.zh: : 懂了。那你想听听我追求一个大概根本不喜欢女生的女孩的最新进展吗？

lines.en: : You are aware that I know her name, correct?
lines.zh: : 你知道我知道她名字的，对吧？

lines.en: scene rindormbed2
: Obviously. But every time I say her name, my heart starts going crazy and my knees get all wobbly and stuff and I don't want you taking advantage of me in my time of hormonal weakness.
lines.zh: : 显然啊。可是每次我一说她的名字，心脏就开始狂跳，膝盖也软得不行什么的，我可不想趁我荷尔蒙虚弱的时候被你占便宜。

lines.en: : You really like her that much?
lines.zh: : 你真的那么喜欢她？

lines.en: scene rindormbed3
: I want to crawl inside of her and sleep there forever.
lines.zh: : 我想钻进她身体里，然后在里面睡上一辈子。

lines.en: scene rindormbed3r
: Dude, I’m kidding.
lines.zh: : 老兄，我开玩笑的。

lines.en: : I’m sorry. I just feel like I never really know with you.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。只是跟你在一起，我总觉得摸不准。

lines.en: scene rindormbed4
: Yeah, that’s fair. I mean, I can't really blame you for thinking that way when my mind's been all over the place lately.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那也难怪。毕竟最近我的脑子一直乱七八糟的，我没法怪你这么想。

lines.en: : And I can't imagine the whole thing with my cutting habit really helping you form a better opinion of me.
lines.zh: : 而且我想，我自残这个习惯大概也没帮上什么忙，没能让你对我有更好的看法。

lines.en: : I never said that...
lines.zh: : 我可从来没那么说过……

lines.en: scene rindormbed5
: You don’t always have to {i}say{/i} something in order for people to understand how you feel, Sensei.
lines.zh: : Sensei，你不一定要{i}说出来{/i}，别人才明白你的感受。

lines.en: : Like, come on. I know that stuff is still in the back of your mind somewhere.
lines.zh: : 拜托。我知道那件事还在你心里的某个角落。

lines.en: : You’re not trying to blame me for {i}worrying{/i} about you, are you?
lines.zh: : 你该不会是在因为{i}担心{/i}你而怪自己吧？

lines.en: : Not at all. If anything, I’m {i}glad{/i} you’re worried about me. I need that sort of relationship in my life to keep me from getting all weird again.
lines.zh: : 完全没有。要说有什么的话，我很{i}高兴{/i}你担心我。我的生命里正需要这种关系，好让我不再变得那么古怪。

lines.en: : Well, I didn’t really plan on talking about this tonight, but since we’re already on the topic, how {i}is{/i} your arm?
lines.zh: : 嗯，我今晚本来没打算聊这个，不过既然都说到这儿了，你的手臂{i}怎么样了{/i}？

lines.en: scene rindormbed6
: Totally fine! It's not like I'm trying to kill myself or anything like that.
lines.zh: : 完全没事！我又不是在试图自杀什么的。

lines.en: : Just a little...wake up call, I guess.
lines.zh: : 只是……给自己提个醒吧，大概。

lines.en: scene rindormbed7
: Plus! You’d be surprised what some decent make-up skills and a healthy body can do! I healed up almost right away.
lines.zh: : 而且！你绝对想不到，过得去的化妆技术加上一副健康的身体能有多管用！我几乎立刻就愈合了。

lines.en: : Speaking of make-up skills, how exactly did we wind up talking about {i}this{/i} when you were seconds away from telling me the latest developments in the Chika saga?
lines.zh: : 说起化妆技术——你差几秒就要告诉我 Chika 连续剧的最新进展了，我们怎么就拐到{i}这个{/i}话题上来了？

lines.en: scene rindormbed7r
: Chika?! What?! Where?! What happened with Chika?!
lines.zh: : Chika？！什么？！在哪儿？！Chika 怎么了？！

lines.en: : Did she say something about me? What was it? Tell me right now!
lines.zh: : 她说我什么了吗？是什么？现在就告诉我！

lines.en: : {i}She{/i} hasn’t said anything about you. You just alluded to some sort of development before our conversation slipped into something way too dark for me right now.
lines.zh: : {i}她{/i}没说你什么。只是在我们的对话滑进对我来说眼下太过沉重的话题之前，你自己暗示有什么进展。

lines.en: scene rindormbed8
: Oh, right.
lines.zh: : 哦，对。

lines.en: : Sorry for the random, depressing tangent. Let’s get to the good part before you lose interest and never talk to me again.
lines.zh: : 抱歉突然扯到那么阴郁的话题。趁你还没失去兴趣、再也不跟我说话，我们赶紧进入好的部分吧。

lines.en: : You can’t freak out when you hear this, though. Got it? Cause it’s kind of a big deal.
lines.zh: : 不过你听到这个可别抓狂。明白吗？因为这可是件大事。

lines.en: A big deal? Rin hasn’t already confessed to her, has she?
lines.zh: 大事？Rin 该不会已经跟她表白了吧？

lines.en: How could I have missed this?
lines.zh: 我怎么可能错过这个？

lines.en: scene rindormbed9
: Okay, so...
: The other day, I was walking home, just mindin’ my own business and listening to music.
lines.zh: : 那天我正走在回家的路上，就顾着自己的事、听着音乐。

lines.en: : Then all of a sudden, out of friggin’ {i}nowhere{/i} she just rounds the corner and starts heading my way.
lines.zh: : 然后突然，该死的，她{i}不知从哪儿{/i}转过街角，朝我这边走来。

lines.en: : So, me being me, I almost threw up due to shock.
lines.zh: : 于是，以我的性子，我差点因为惊吓吐出来。

lines.en: : BUT...I managed to NOT throw up and was actually able to talk to her instead!
lines.zh: : 但是……我成功忍住没吐，而且居然还跟她说上了话！

lines.en: : Okay...and what did you two talk about?
lines.zh: : 好……那你们两个聊了什么？

lines.en: scene rindormbed10
: Oh, you know. A little of this. A little of that.
lines.zh: : 哦，你知道的。聊了点这个，聊了点那个。

lines.en: : School...The weather...TV...
lines.zh: : 学校……天气……电视……

lines.en: : Mostly just normal high school stuff.
lines.zh: : 基本都是普通高中生的那套。

lines.en: scene rindormbed9
: BUT! Then, something {i}amazing{/i} happened.
lines.zh: : 但是！然后，{i}神奇{/i}的事情发生了。

lines.en: : Did you two make out?
lines.zh: : 你们两个接吻了？

lines.en: scene rindormbed11
: God, I wish...
lines.zh: : 天啊，我真希望……

lines.en: scene rindormbed12
: But no...
lines.zh: : 不过没有……

lines.en: : She DID say that I looked cute, though! Which is only like, a step away from making out I think.
lines.zh: : 但她确实说了我很可爱！我觉得那大概离接吻也就一步之遥了。

lines.en: : So...maybe next time if I'm lucky.
lines.zh: : 所以……如果运气好，也许下次就成了。

lines.en: scene rindormbed3
: Come on! Aren’t you gonna say anything? That’s like, a super big deal. It means there’s a {i}chance{/i}!
lines.zh: : 拜托！你倒是说点什么啊？那可是件超级大的事。这说明我是有{i}机会{/i}的！

lines.en: : Sorry, I think I may have set my expectations a little too high and it made the payoff very much not worth it.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，我大概把期待值设得有点太高了，结果这个回报实在不太值。

lines.en: : But either way, I'm happy for you.
lines.zh: : 不过不管怎样，我为你高兴。

lines.en: if chikatownfirst == True:
: I don’t know if I’d get my hopes up if I were you, though.
lines.zh: : 不过换作是我，我不会抱太大希望。

lines.en: : You still don’t really know if she’s into girls.
lines.zh: : 你到现在也不确定她到底喜不喜欢女生。

lines.en: scene rindormbed13
: Yeah, I know...
lines.zh: : 嗯，我知道……

lines.en: : It’s a really weird spot to be in...not knowing if your crush is into the same sex as you.
lines.zh: : 这处境真的很怪……不知道你暗恋的人跟你是不是同性。

lines.en: : Like, no one other than you and maaaaybe Futaba knows about this side of me.
lines.zh: : 就是说，除了你、还有大概 Futaba 之外，没人知道我的这一面。

lines.en: : Don’t call it a ‘side’ if it’s just who you are, Rin.
lines.zh: : 如果那只是你本来的样子，就别管它叫什么「一面」了，Rin。

lines.en: scene rindormbed14
: Thanks, Sensei...But it’s a little more complicated than that.
lines.zh: : 谢啦，Sensei……不过事情比那要复杂一点。

lines.en: : Like...what if I {i}do{/i} tell her and she thinks it’s weird?
lines.zh: : 比如……要是我{i}真的{/i}告诉她，而她觉得这很怪呢？

lines.en: : Or...or even worse-
lines.zh: : 或者……或者更糟——

lines.en: : What if she’s already into someone else?...
lines.zh: : 万一她已经喜欢上别人了呢？……

lines.en: My mind quickly travels back to when Chika and I kissed in the second half of town.
lines.zh: 我的思绪迅速飘回我和 Chika 在城另一头接吻的那个时候。

lines.en: I still have no idea if I should tell Rin or not...
lines.zh: 我到现在也不知道该不该告诉 Rin……

lines.en: But I can’t imagine right now being the best time either way.
lines.zh: 但我也觉得，无论如何现在都不是最好的时机。

lines.en: Tearing her out of the first good mood she's been in since I found out about her darker, less lesbian secret would just be...
lines.zh: 把她从我发现她那个阴暗的、不那么女同的秘密以来最好的心情里拽出来，只会是……

lines.en: Well, not a thing I'd want to do.
lines.zh: 嗯，一件我不想做的事。

lines.en: Basically, I don't want to be the reason she spirals out of control again.
lines.zh: 基本上，我不想成为她再次失控的原因。

lines.en: else:
: Hearing that is definitely a big deal.
lines.zh: : 听到那句话确实是件大事。

lines.en: : Plus, even if she’s {i}not{/i} into girls, it at least means you’re kind of her type, right?
lines.zh: : 而且，就算她{i}不{/i}喜欢女生，那至少也说明你有点她的菜，对吧？

lines.en: scene rindormbed5
: Well...I don’t know if I’d go that far.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我可不敢说到那份上。

lines.en: : Chika’s super into those really cutesy idol-type girls. And here I am wearing a t-shirt and basketball shorts.
lines.zh: : Chika 超喜欢那种特别可爱的偶像型女生。而我呢，穿着一件 T 恤加篮球短裤。

lines.en: : She’d probably take one look at me in this condition and think ‘Wow, if I were a lesbian, I totally wouldn’t want THAT girl’ or something.
lines.zh: : 她看到我这副样子，大概会想「哇，就算我是女同，我也绝对不想要那个女孩」什么的。

lines.en: : You know?
lines.zh: : 你懂吧？

lines.en: : I don’t think I do.
lines.zh: : 我好像不懂。

lines.en: : I like your basketball shorts, personally.
lines.zh: : 我个人还挺喜欢你的篮球短裤的。

lines.en: : Yeah, but you have a penis and it’s a reflex for you to say stuff like that when you’re in close proximity to girls.
lines.zh: : 是啊，可你有根阴茎，而且只要靠近女生就会条件反射地说这种话。

lines.en: : Attacking me when I am defenseless is rude.
lines.zh: : 趁我毫无防备的时候攻击我，是很失礼的。

lines.en: scene rindormbed7
: Maybe! But it's the best time to strike!
lines.zh: : 也许吧！不过那正是出手的最好时机！

lines.en: Rin pauses for a moment and sighs to herself-
lines.zh: Rin 停顿了一下，独自叹了口气——

lines.en: scene rindormbed15
And...I guess now she’s on my shoulder?
lines.zh: 然后……我猜她现在靠到我肩上来了？

lines.en: : You know, I’m really glad I have someone like you to talk to, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，Sensei，我真的很高兴有你这样的人可以聊天。

lines.en: : It’s weird being able to chat about all of my secrets so openly without the fear of you walking away or whatever.
lines.zh: : 能这么坦白地聊我所有的秘密，还不用担心你会走掉什么的，这种感觉很奇妙。

lines.en: scene rindormbed16
: And sorry for suddenly using your shoulder as a headrest. It just felt like the right thing to do in the moment.
lines.zh: : 还有，抱歉突然把你的肩膀当枕头用。只是那一瞬间觉得这么做才对。

lines.en: : If you’re uncomfortable, you can ask me to move.
lines.zh: : 你要是不舒服，可以叫我挪开。

lines.en: : {i}I’m{/i} fine. If anything, I figured you would be the one uncomfortable.
lines.zh: : {i}我{/i}没事。要说有什么的话，我还以为不舒服的会是你。

lines.en: : Why’s that?
lines.zh: : 为什么这么说？

lines.en: : Because you like Chika, not me.
lines.zh: : 因为你喜欢的是 Chika，不是我。

lines.en: : You don’t need to {i}like{/i} someone to lean on them, you know...
lines.zh: : 你不需要{i}喜欢{/i}一个人才能靠着他，你知道吗……

lines.en: scene rindormbed17
: Besides, it’s not like there's some kind of rule preventing you from liking two people at once, is there?
lines.zh: : 再说了，又没有什么规矩规定你不能同时喜欢两个人，对吧？

lines.en: : You’re not stalking {i}my{/i} Instagram, too, are you?
lines.zh: : 你该不会也在偷偷刷{i}我的{/i} Instagram 吧？

lines.en: scene rindormbed18
: Hey, you don’t even have an Instagram! I checked!
lines.zh: : 嘿，你根本就没有 Instagram！我查过了！

lines.en: : What did you even search for? You don’t know my name.
lines.zh: : 你到底搜了什么？你连我的名字都不知道。

lines.en: : I don’t need to know your name! I have my ways!
lines.zh: : 我不需要知道你的名字！我自有办法！

lines.en: scene rindormbed19
: This ain’t my first rodeo, dude. If I wanna find out more information about somebody, by golly I’m gonna do it.
lines.zh: : 这我可不是第一次干，老兄。我想挖谁的信息，天塌下来我也要挖。

lines.en: : Please refrain from stalking me, if at all possible.
lines.zh: : 请尽量别跟踪我。

lines.en: : I will do what I want and you won’t stop me!
lines.zh: : 我想干什么就干什么，你拦不住我！

lines.en: scene black
Rin's head does not leave my shoulder until it comes time for me to leave roughly an hour later.
lines.zh: 大约一小时后我该走了，Rin 的头才离开我的肩膀。

lines.en: Within that time, we manage to talk about all sorts of things.
lines.zh: 在那段时间里，我们聊了各种各样的事。

lines.en: But each and every one of them leads back to the one she really loves.
lines.zh: 但每一件最后都会绕回她真正爱的那一个。

lines.en: Or, at the very least-
lines.zh: 或者，至少——

lines.en: The one she {i}thinks{/i} she loves.
lines.zh: 绕回她{i}以为{/i}自己爱着的那个。

lines.en: $ rin_love += 1
$ rindorm25 = True
{i}Rin’s affection has increased to [rin_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Rin 的好感度提升到了 [rin_love]!{/i}
